description: Adds up each ingredient across several products taken together (up to 12) and compares each daily total with the adult upper limit of the country, with the same rules engine as the Verateca site. For every ingredient: total per day, applicable limit, share of the limit, status ("within the upper limit", "over the upper limit", "no upper limit set" or "not compared"), the products that contribute, and duplicates across products. Limits of other countries follow. Interactions with medicines are not checked.

country.description: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) of the person. Limits of this country come first. Default US.

product_id.description: Verateca product id, e.g. "US:302778", as returned by search_products.

servings_per_day.description: Servings a day the person takes. Default: the label dose.

name: check_stack
title: Check a set of supplements
